name: addToPath
description: Adds a directory to the system PATH (or LD_LIBRARY_PATH on Unix).
returns: Non-zero if the path was modified

name: appendArgs
description: Appends all arguments into one string verbatim, avoiding undesired string interpolation.
example:
set result [appendArgs "Hello, " $name "!"]
# Equivalent to: set result "Hello, ${name}!"

name: appendFile
description: Appends data to a binary file.

name: appendLogFile
description: Appends data to a log file.

name: appendSharedFile
description: Appends to a file with shared access.

name: appendSharedLogFile
description: Appends data to a shared log file (allows concurrent access).

name: canGetManagedType
description: Checks if a name is usable as a CLR type name, optionally with member access.

args.name: allowExtra
args.description: Allow extra parts after type name

args.name: typeVarName
args.description: Variable to store the type name

name: canUseComSpecDir
description: Checks if file searches can use the Windows command shell dir command.

name: checkForEngine
description: Checks for new Eagle engine versions.

name: checkForUpdate
description: Main procedure to check for software updates.

name: combineFlags
description: Combines two flag strings and optionally excludes specified flags.
example:
# Combine enumeration flags
set flags [combineFlags "Public" "Instance"]
# Returns: "Public, Instance"

name: compileViaCSharpCodeProvider
signature: compileViaCSharpCodeProvider string memory symbols strict resultsVarName errorsVarName args
description: Compiles C# code using CSharpCodeProvider (desktop .NET Framework).

name: compileViaDotNetCoreCSharp
signature: compileViaDotNetCoreCSharp string memory symbols strict resultsVarName errorsVarName args
description: Compiles C# code using the .NET Core SDK command-line compiler.

name: copyFilesRecursive
description: Copies files recursively using Robocopy (Windows only).

name: csharpLog
description: Logs C# compilation lifecycle stages.

args.name: object
args.description: Optional object to include properties from

name: doesCompileCSharpWork
description: Tests if the C# compiler is working.

name: downloadAndExtractNativeTclKitDll
description: Downloads and extracts the native TclKit DLL for the current platform.

name: downloadAndExtractNativeTclTkDlls
description: Downloads and extracts native Tcl/Tk DLLs for the current platform.

name: downloadAndExtractPackageClientToolset
description: Downloads and extracts the Package Client Toolset.

name: downloadAndExtractSecurityToolset
description: Downloads and extracts the Security Toolset (Harpy and Badge plugins).

name: downloadExampleScript
description: Downloads and saves a named example script.

name: evalAsync
description: Evaluates a script asynchronously with optional completion notification.

args.name: doneScript
args.description: Script to run when evaluation completes (empty for no notification)

name: evaluateInRemoteSandbox
description: Submits a script to the remote sandbox for evaluation.

name: execShell
description: Executes a native Tcl or Eagle sub-shell with the specified arguments.
example: set result [execShell {} -c {puts "Hello from sub-shell"}]

name: exportAndImportPackageCommands
description: Exports commands from a namespace and imports them into the global namespace.

args.name: exports
args.description: List of command names to export

args.name: forget
args.description: If true, forget previous imports first

example: exportAndImportPackageCommands [namespace current] [list myProc1 myProc2] true true

name: filter
description: Returns elements from the list for which the script returns non-zero.

args.name: script
args.description: Script that receives each element and returns a boolean

example:
set numbers {1 2 3 4 5 6}
set evens [filter $numbers {expr {$item % 2 == 0}}]  ;# Returns: {2 4 6}

name: filterForGlob
description: Filters glob results to remove unwanted entries like "." and "..".

name: findDirectories
description: Finds directories matching a pattern (non-recursive).
example: set dirs [findDirectories "/home/user/*"]

name: findDirectoriesRecursive
description: Finds directories matching a pattern (recursive).

name: findFiles
description: Finds files matching a pattern (non-recursive).
example: set scripts [findFiles "*.eagle"]

name: findFilesRecursive
description: Finds files matching a pattern (recursive).

name: forceScanOfPackages
description: Forces a rescan of all available package indexes.

name: foundInPath
description: Checks if a directory is in a list of directories (case-insensitive on Windows).

name: getBasePath
description: Returns the Eagle core library base path.
returns: Base directory path (e.g., "C:\Eagle" when loaded from "C:\Eagle\bin\Eagle.dll")

name: getBogusPackageName
description: Builds a package name that never exists to force package index refresh.

name: getCSharpTestProgram
description: Returns a C# test program for compiler verification.
returns: List with class name and program text

name: getColumnValue
description: Gets the value of a database column from a row.

args.name: default
args.description: Default value if column not found

args.name: wrap
args.description: String to wrap around the value

name: getCompileInfo
description: Returns compile-time information for the Eagle core library.
returns: List with TimeStamp, ImageRuntimeVersion, ModuleVersionId, and CompileOptions

name: getDefaultValue
description: Returns the default value for a CLR type.
returns: `0` for value types, `"null"` for reference types

name: getDictionaryValue
description: Finds and returns a named value from a dictionary (list of name-value pairs).

args.name: dictionary
args.description: List in format `{name1 value1 name2 value2 ...}`

args.name: wrap
args.description: String to wrap around the value

returns: The found value (optionally wrapped) or the default

name: getDotNetCoreSdkPath
description: Returns the path to the .NET Core SDK.
returns: SDK path or empty string on error

name: getDotNetStandardReferencePath
description: Returns the path to .NET Standard reference assemblies.

name: getEnvironmentVariable
description: Returns the value of an environment variable, or empty string if it doesn't exist.
returns: The environment variable value or empty string
example:
set home [getEnvironmentVariable HOME]
set path [getEnvironmentVariable PATH]

name: getExternalIpAddress
description: Queries and returns the current external IP address.
example: debugBreakWithNewConsole args

name: getHostSize
description: Returns the host console size in columns and rows.
returns: List `{columns rows}`, defaults to `{80 25}` if unavailable

name: getOwnerForProcess
description: Determines the owner of a process.

name: getPackageInstallPath
description: Returns the directory where packages should be installed.

args.name: temporaryPrefix
args.description: Prefix for temporary directory if Tcl library unavailable

name: getPlatformInfo
description: Returns specific Eagle platform information.

name: getPluginFlags
description: Returns the flags for the first loaded plugin matching a pattern.

name: getPluginName
description: Returns the name of the first loaded plugin matching a pattern.

name: getPluginPath
description: Returns the file path of the first loaded plugin matching a pattern.
returns: Plugin file path or empty string

name: getProcesses
description: Returns a list of process IDs matching a name.

name: getReturnType
description: Returns the type name of the return type for a CLR member.

name: getRowColumnValue
description: Gets a column value from a specific row in an array of rows.

args.name: varName
args.description: Name of array variable containing rows

args.name: wrap
args.description: String to wrap around the value

name: getRuntimeCommandLine
description: Returns command line arguments needed to run an executable on the current runtime.

name: getShellExecutableName
description: Returns the fully qualified file name for the shell executable.
returns: Path to the shell executable (native or managed)

name: getStringFromObjectHandle
description: Converts an opaque object handle to a string.

name: getUpdateFileName
description: Returns the path to the updates.tsv file.

name: hasRuntimeOption
description: Checks if a runtime option is currently set.

name: haveColumnValue
description: Checks if a database column exists within a row.

name: haveGaruda
description: Checks if the Eagle Native Package for Tcl (Garuda) is loaded.

args.name: varName
args.description: Optional variable to store the Garuda package ID

name: haveRowColumnValue
description: Checks if a column exists within a specific row in an array of rows.

args.name: varName
args.description: Name of array variable containing rows

returns: Non-zero if the column exists in the specified row

name: help
description: Displays help via the interactive "#help" command.

name: isAdministrator
description: Checks if the current user has administrator privileges.

name: isBasicType
description: Checks if a CLR object is a basic type (losslessly convertible to string).

name: isDotNetCore
description: Detects if running in Eagle on .NET Core (or .NET 5+).

name: isEagle
description: Detects whether the script is running in Eagle or vanilla Tcl.
returns: Non-zero if running in Eagle, zero if running in Tcl

name: isInteractive
description: Checks if there is an interactive user who can respond to prompts.

name: isMacOS
description: Detects if running on macOS (Darwin).

name: isManagedType
description: Checks if a name represents a valid CLR type.

name: isMono
description: Detects if running in Eagle on the Mono runtime.

name: isNonNullObjectHandle
description: Checks if a value is a valid, non-null object handle.
example:
set obj [object create System.Object]
isNonNullObjectHandle $obj     ;# Returns: 1
object dispose $obj

name: isObjectHandle
description: Checks if a value can be used as an opaque object handle.
example:
set obj [object create System.Object]
isObjectHandle $obj            ;# Returns: 1
isObjectHandle "not an object" ;# Returns: 0
object dispose $obj

name: isSameFileName
description: Compares two file names for equality using the most robust method available.
returns: Non-zero if the files are the same

name: isTclThread
description: Checks if a name represents a thread managed by the native Tcl integration subsystem.
returns: Non-zero if it's a Tcl thread

name: isUpdateInstalled
description: Checks if a specific update is installed.

args.name: script
args.description: Optional script to evaluate for each found update

name: isWindows
description: Detects if running on Windows.

name: lappendArgs
description: Appends all arguments as list elements and returns the resulting list.
example: set items [lappendArgs "a" "b" "c"]  ;# Returns: {a b c}

name: ldifference
description: Returns elements present in one list but not the other (symmetric difference).
returns: List of elements unique to either list

name: listExampleScripts
description: Lists available named example scripts.

name: listRuntimeOptions
description: Returns a list of runtime options that are currently set.

name: loadGarudaForUseByEagle
description: Loads the native Tcl library, enables command bridging, and loads the Eagle Native Package for Tcl (Garuda).

args.name: methodFlags
args.description: Garuda method flags (default: true for METHOD_PROTOCOL_V1R2)

name: loadPackageClientToolset
signature: loadPackageClientToolset {directory auto} {apiKeys ""} {hookUnknown true} {enableSecurity true} {isolateSecurity false} {strictSecurity false} {fetchKeyRing false} {debug false}
description: Loads the package client toolset via package require.

name: loadScripts
description: Sources other script files that belong to the package.

args.name: fileNamesOnly
args.description: List of script file names to load

name: lshuffle
description: Pseudo-randomly shuffles a list using the Fisher-Yates algorithm.
example:
set cards {1 2 3 4 5}
set shuffled [lshuffle $cards]  ;# e.g., {3 1 5 2 4}

name: makeAsciiChannel
description: Reconfigures a channel for ASCII mode with auto line-ending translation.

name: makeBinaryChannel
description: Reconfigures a channel for full binary mode.

name: makeLogChannel
description: Reconfigures a channel for use by the logging subsystem.

name: makeProcedureFast
description: Experimental optimization hint. Marks a procedure for potential fast-path execution by the interpreter engine. The exact effect is implementation-defined and may change.
example:
# Mark a hot-path procedure for optimization
makeProcedureFast myProc true

name: makeUnicodeBinaryChannel
description: Reconfigures a channel for Unicode mode with binary (no) line-ending translation.

name: makeUnicodeChannel
description: Reconfigures a channel for Unicode mode with auto line-ending translation.

name: makeUpdateId
description: Creates an identifier for use with update tracking.

name: makeUtf8Channel
description: Reconfigures a channel for UTF-8 mode.

name: makeVariableFast
description: Experimental optimization hint. Marks a variable for potential fast-path access by the interpreter engine. The exact effect is implementation-defined and may change.
example:
# Mark a frequently-accessed variable for optimization
makeVariableFast myVar true

name: map
description: Applies a transformation script to each list element.

args.name: script
args.description: Script that receives each element and returns transformed value

example:
set numbers {1 2 3 4}
set doubled [map $numbers {expr {$item * 2}}]  ;# Returns: {2 4 6 8}

name: markUpdateInstalled
description: Marks an update as installed or removes the installation mark.

args.name: installed
args.description: True to mark installed, false to unmark

name: maybeGetExitCode
description: Extracts the exit code from $::errorCode after an exec command.

args.name: default
args.description: Default value if no exit code found

returns: Exit code as integer or default

name: maybeLoadScripts
description: Like loadScripts, but skips files that have been explicitly forbidden via ::no($fileNameOnly).

args.name: fileNamesOnly
args.description: List of script file names to load

name: parray
description: Prints the contents of an array to stdout, emulating the native Tcl parray procedure.

args.name: pattern
args.description: Optional glob pattern to filter names

example:
array set data {name "John" age 30 city "NYC"}
parray data
# Output:
# data(age)  = 30
# data(city) = NYC
# data(name) = John

name: pdict
description: Prints the contents of a dictionary to stdout.

name: populateTypesForComSpecDir
description: Populates arrays with type options for the Windows dir command.

name: populateTypesForGlob
description: Populates arrays with -types option values for glob.

name: quit
description: Exits the interactive shell.
example: #support

name: readAsciiFile
description: Reads all data from an ASCII text file.

name: readFile
description: Reads all data from a binary file.
example: set data [readFile "image.png"]

name: readSharedFile
description: Reads from a file with shared access (allows concurrent readers/writers).

name: readUnicodeBinaryFile
description: Reads from a Unicode binary file (no line-ending translation).

name: readUnicodeFile
description: Reads all data from a Unicode file.

name: readUtf8File
description: Reads from a UTF-8 file.

name: reduce
description: Reduces a list to a single value by applying a script cumulatively.

args.name: script
args.description: Script receiving `result` and `item`, returns accumulated value

example:
set numbers {1 2 3 4 5}
set sum [reduce $numbers {expr {$result + $item}}]  ;# Returns: 15

name: removeFromPath
description: Removes a directory from the system PATH.
returns: Non-zero if the path was modified

name: removeRuntimeOption
description: Removes a runtime option.

name: requestLicenseCertificate
description: Requests an Eagle license certificate from the license server.

name: runUpdateAndExit
description: Runs the updater tool and exits the process.

name: setupPackageToolsetVars
description: Sets up default configuration for the package toolset.

name: setupUnzipVars
description: Sets up default configuration parameters for the unzip package.

args.name: force
args.description: Force setup even if already done

name: sourceWithInfo
description: Sources a script file while preserving location information for procedures defined within it.
example: sourceWithInfo "mylib.eagle"    ;# Same as source, but tracks procedure locations

name: tclLog
description: Emulates the native Tcl tclLog command by writing to stderr.

name: tclLogForCommand
description: Emits a Tcl log message based on the calling procedure.

args.name: command
args.description: Optional command to include in log

name: tclPkgUnknown
description: Package unknown handler. Called automatically when package require cannot find a package. Re-scans auto_path directories for pkgIndex.tcl files to discover newly available packages.

name: test
description: Emulates the native Tcl test command from the tcltest package. Automatically detects old-style vs new-style tests.

name: toggleRuntimeOption
description: Toggles a runtime option or sets it to a specific value.

args.name: value
args.description: Specific value to set (empty to toggle)

name: tqlog
description: Adds a message to the test log queue for later writing.

name: tqputs
description: Emits a message to a channel and adds it to the test log queue.

name: unknown
description: Unknown command handler for safe interpreters - simply raises an error.
example:
# Default behavior: error for unknown commands
unknown nonexistentCmd    ;# Error: invalid command name "nonexistentCmd"

# With eagleUnknownObjectInvoke, CLR types become commands:
# System.Math Max 1 2      ;# Returns: 2  (if runtime option is set)

name: unknownObjectInvoke
description: Handler for the unknown command that treats command names as CLR type names.

args.name: name
args.description: Unknown command name (treated as type name)

name: unzipMustBeInstalled
description: Verifies that the unzip command line tool is installed.

name: vwaitLocked
description: Locks a variable while evaluating a script (thread-safe).

args.name: isArray
args.description: True if variable is an array

name: waitForProcesses
description: Waits for processes to exit within a timeout.

args.name: kill
args.description: Kill processes if they don't exit

name: writeAsciiFile
description: Writes data to an ASCII text file.

name: writeFile
description: Writes data to a binary file (overwrites existing content).

name: writeUnicodeBinaryFile
description: Writes to a Unicode binary file.

name: writeUnicodeFile
description: Writes data to a Unicode file.

name: writeUtf8File
description: Writes to a UTF-8 file.
